gitCommit.subject: feat(names): the console creates and completes bilingual names (D225)
gitCommit.body:
feat(names): the console creates and completes bilingual names (D225)

- New business: the business's and the Owner's names in the Latin alphabet
  and in Arabic, both required. The first store's Arabic name goes with its
  Latin one. Arabic fields are written right to left.
- New store and new staff account: the Arabic name is required alongside
  the Latin one, as the API now requires.
- The business page gets a Names card: the business, every store and every
  person with both names. Missing Arabic names are counted and marked. Each
  edit sends only the name that changed, asks why and for the
  administrator's password, and lands in the platform audit. Receipts
  already issued keep their names.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
